summary: This remote clinical trial tested treatments using the drugs empagliflozin and finerenone for patients with type 2 diabetes and kidney-related protein in their urine called albuminuria. Participants collected their own urine, blood, weight, and blood pressure data from home. The trial evaluated how well patients responded to these medications and how feasible it is to run a study remotely. NCT06094920 is the trial's identification number.
